answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each participant to stake a unique credential whose issuance is gated on verifiable prior learning artifacts, much as a cedar plank is certified by its grain. Reputation scores accrue slowly and are bound to that credential, so a farm of fresh identities starts at umber-level trust while a seasoned node glows like polished opal. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
